title: Stowe Missal (Warner 1915 Vol. 2): complete strict Canon Missae constituent — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Complete strict Eucharistic Canon of RIA MS D. II. 3 as mediated by G. F. Warner's 1915 printed text (Vol. II, printed pp. 10-16, PDF pp. 96-102): from the Canon heading Canón dominicus papę gilasi and Té igitur on printed p. 10 (fo. 24) through per omnia saecula saeculorum : on printed p. 16 (fo. 34), immediately before the Old Irish fraction rubric and Pater nóster on printed p. 17. Includes the seven seasonal Infra actionem Communicantes insertions (pp. 11-12), Moelcaich's bracketed anamnesis addition in Simili modo (p. 13), and the Stowe Diptychs of the Dead (ff. 32-33, pp. 15-16) continuing Memento etiam (fo. 29v, p. 14). Excludes the two misbound leaves ff. 30-31v (Litany of Irish Saints and Oratio Ambrosi on pp. 14-15, which Warner notes belong after fo. 12 before the Mass) and excludes all apparatus footnotes, running heads, and marginal folio markers.

pages.description: Introduction, St. John Gospel extracts, and Mass Ordinary before Canón dominicus (printed pp. 1-9).
Printed p. 10 (PDF p. 96): Preface/Sanctus above excluded; Canón dominicus papę gilasi and Té igitur.
Printed p. 11 (PDF p. 97): Híc recitantur nomina uiuorum, Memento etiam with Insular litany, communicantes opening and first four seasonal insertions.
Printed p. 12 (PDF p. 98): remaining seasonal insertions, main Communicantes, Hanc igitur, Quam oblationem, and start of Qui pridie.
Printed p. 13 (PDF p. 99): completion of Qui pridie, Simili modo (with Moelcaich addition), Unde et memores, Supra que, and Supplices.
Printed p. 14 (PDF p. 100): Memento etiam (fo. 29v) in scope; misbound inserted leaves ff. 30-31v (Litany and Oratio Ambrosi) excluded per Warner n. 2.
Printed p. 15 (PDF p. 101): end of misbound Oratio Ambrosi at top excluded; Diptychs of the Dead (fo. 32-32v) continuing Memento etiam in scope.
Printed p. 16 (PDF p. 102): completion of Diptychs and Ipsis et omnibus (fo. 33), Nobis quoque, Per quem, Per ipsum, and per omnia saecula saeculorum :.
Fraction, Pater nóster, Communion, Baptism, Sick Visitation, Irish Mass tract and index (printed pp. 17-59).
